title: Flight search and offers (flight_searches.status, expiry)
caption: src/shopping/searches.service.ts and offers-purge.processor.ts (offers.purge every 15 min, ≤ 500 searches per job). A search is kept while a checkout's priced offer references it (RESTRICT).

states.label: pending
states.detail: Row written before Flight Offers Search.

states.label: completed
states.detail: Offers stored (`result_count`, facets); listResults filters in SQL. After `expires_at`: getSearch answers `status: expired` (no 410), listResults `410 SEARCH_EXPIRED`, getOffer and price `410 OFFER_EXPIRED`. A pending or failed search: listResults `409 SEARCH_NOT_COMPLETED`.

states.label: purged (row deleted)
states.detail: Deleted with its offers, upsells and priced offers once expired and unreferenced.
